subject.title: [Bug]: Node invoke timeout semantics diverge across Gateway and node

question: Should maintainers sponsor this protected issue as the canonical narrow Gateway timeout-semantics fix now?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-reproducible, but the maintainer label and assignment require explicit human handling before cleanup automation or repair routing.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Gateway Fix
options.body: Normalize the timeout once in Gateway node.invoke and add focused node-registry/server-method regression coverage for zero and oversized values.

options.title: Fold Into Adjacent Timeout Work
options.body: Keep this issue open only if an explicitly linked node timeout PR also fixes per-call zero and forwarded-clamp semantics.

options.title: Defer Protected Tracker
options.body: Leave this protected issue open without repair until the assigned maintainer chooses the timeout contract and priority.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Gateway Fix
recommendation.body: Normalize the timeout once in Gateway node.invoke and add focused node-registry/server-method regression coverage for zero and oversized values.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned on GitHub and has the strongest current-history ownership signal for the affected Gateway/node path.
